purpose: Common conditional controller across all plant sensitivities; not an operating or certified protection system
observation_basis: Position, speed and acceleration signals are simulated observations with explicit injected biases. Grade and drive-fault notifications are explicit scenario observations, not surveyed data or authenticated sensors/diagnostics.
model_stop_boundary: Exactly the declared route target D. The existing plus/minus berth accuracy does not expand modeled travel authority or establish physical clearance.
standstill_observation_basis: Docking additionally assumes an ideal zero-speed event. No measured detector integrity is supplied. Docking requests 0.25 m/s and has a 0.5 m/s model guard; neither is a qualified physical limit.
model_domain: Constant grade and nonnegative headwind only; forward aerodynamic assistance is unsupported. No future gradient profile, wheel-slide, localization dropout, flexible train or safety-system proof.
maturity: Uncalibrated research assumptions; mass bounds include counted stock and explicit reserves, not verified installed mass

source_principles.title: ERA Introduction to ETCS braking curves, version 1.5
source_principles.use: Methodological reference for measured-state uncertainty, braking buildup and track characteristics; no ETCS implementation, applicability or compliance claim
